hooks.command: f="${ENGRAM_HOME:-$HOME/engram}/scripts/dotfiles.py"; [ -f "$f" ] && { command -v python3 >/dev/null && python3 "$f" apply || python "$f" apply; } || true

f="${ENGRAM_HOME:-$HOME/engram}/scripts/sync.sh"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; if command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then setsid nohup bash "$f" push >/dev/null 2>&1 & else nohup bash "$f" push >/dev/null 2>&1 & fi
